title: Flight in a WW 2 fighter aircraft
text:
We have all seen these kinds of aircraft in the movies. We had always wondered what it would be like to experience a flight in one of these warbirds. The sounds, manoeuvres smells … I can’t put it into words.
Jeroen (airline pilot on the big ones but also expert on old aircraft like these) was our pilot. He made us feel right at home. Thanks Jeroen!
author: tjack90
